prose.text: **The gates:** - blitz-dom's and blitz-paint's own unit tests, the custom-widget replay test among them (gates 1, 2); - the three new checks per package, each read red before its fix (gates 3–5), and the text check under   `blitz-paint/font-embolden` (gate 6, the local witness of a paint change under that feature); - the two standing widget readers, `stand_canvas_shot` and `custom_widget_layout`, which the fix must leave green   (gate 7), then the whole of blitz-tests per package (gate 8); - the lock probe: one line added, none removed (gate 9; no line on the untouched tree); - the pre-push gate `fast` (workspace tests, both clippy lines — blitz-dom's `--no-default-features … custom-widget`   line among them — and `embolden`), the `doc` leg (two new public doc comments; test-plan ·   9-ci-integration/decision/doc-leg-gates-public-doc-edits), the `audit` leg (the lock moves; security-plan ·   dependency-security/decision/local-audit-before-push) and `stand-repeat`, which takes the three `stand_` checks by   their prefix (gates 10–13); - revision 1's step 10: the lock probe re-measured for the two moves together, the `parley` line and the two `cookie`   lines (gate 9, `3+2`); the `--locked` workspace build on the moved lock (gate 14, `ci-leg.sh build`); the audit   leg green on it (gate 12).

**What step 10 re-fires, and why only these.** The move changes `cookie`'s version and checksum and nothing else in the lock. Gate 9 reads the lock's line count, so it moves. Gate 14 compiles every workspace crate against `cookie` 0.18.3, which covers its one reach (`cookie_store` ← `reqwest` ← `blitz-net`). Gate 12 reads the advisory. Gates 1–8, 10, 11 and 13 stay as the implement recorded them: no workspace test, doc comment or stand check reads a cookie (`git grep -n -i cookie -- '*.rs'` finds the store switched on at `packages/blitz-net/src/lib.rs:90-91` behind the `cookies` feature and comments; no test file), and a patch release that compiles cannot change their readings.

**What no step changes:** no boot path or binary start (no served task holds a widget; the stand's boots are untouched), so no smoke entry; no log site, span or field; no served task, kept check or committed check, so `host_log`, `mcp_log`, `stand_cross_os_readings`' table and the cold-agent pipe move nothing (all read inside `fast` and `stand-repeat`); no a11y leg file. There is no live leg and no headful self-verify on this project.
**Controls.** Each new check is red before its fix (steps 1, 3, 6) and under step 8's one-shot `gate.py control`; gate 9 reads no line on the untouched tree. No other new control.

The diff is not OS-sensitive: no OS `cfg` site is added (the added `cfg`s are the `custom-widget` feature's). The text check compares two widgets on one host and pins no rasterized pixel, so CI's macOS and Windows test legs read it as Linux does.
